solutions.title: Seen set cycle detection
solutions.strategy: Store transformed values and stop when one is reached or a value repeats.

timeComplexity.explanation: Each transform processes the current digits; the sequence quickly enters a bounded cycle for base 10 integers.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The seen set stores generated values until termination.

solutions.title: Floyd cycle detection
solutions.strategy: Advance one transformed value by one step and another by two steps until they meet or one reaches one.

timeComplexity.explanation: The same bounded transform sequence is followed with constant extra state.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only slow and fast values are stored.
